name: virtual-list
title: Virtual List
description: A long list or grid that renders only the rows in view: thousands of items of any height in a box that scrolls, each still announced with its position in the whole list, with a way to go to an item and to come back to where the person was.

meta.when: More items than the page should hold at once (a few hundred or more): a feed, a log, search results, a picture library. Rows may have any height: each is measured once it is drawn and the rest are estimated, and the view does not jump when a row above it turns out taller. Give the box a height and a name (`aria-label`). For a short list render the rows plainly; for a conversation that grows at the bottom use thread; for pages of results use pagination. Written here on ResizeObserver instead of adding a virtualisation package: a headless one would bring the offsets but not the roles, the positions for screen readers, the kept focus or the restoration, which are most of this file. It scrolls inside its own box only, not with the window.
